label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/xss): alert-TP. User input flows from request.getParameterValues into param, then into valuesList. Although valuesList initially contains ['safe', param, 'moresafe'], the call valuesList.remove(0) deletes the 'safe' entry, shifting param to index 0. Consequently, bar = valuesList.get(0) resolves to the original user-controlled param. Finally, bar is embedded in obj and written to the HTML response body via out.format() without HTML encoding. The resolved sink value is attacker-controlled user input.

evidence.note: User input added to list alongside constants
Remove shifts user input to index 0
Retrieves shifted user input into bar
Writes bar to HTML response without sanitization
